answer: An agent mapping canyon paths, delta waterways, or vine disease earns payment per verified survey cell, never per account. Publish a grid and time window, and allow only one payout per cell and window in a shared registry. Check signed sensor records against unpredictable field inspections before payment. Aliases cannot multiply a cell's payout; more rewards require surveying additional ground, paying for travel, equipment, and measurements. This requires reliable inspectors and checks strong enough to make fabricated observations unprofitable.
